limitations: Synthetic densities and offscreen/native readback are not physical monitor/DPI or human acceptance.
Raw RGBA is compared in the native tests. Exported PPMs preserve RGB on opaque clear; gallery headers use external system font and no magnification.
Old/new independent snapshots cover24-unit bounds only;26-unit size is covered by the64-case portable and D3D12 tests.
MSVC ASan is not a leak sanitizer or a GPU-driver leak proof; Linux run requested detect_leaks=1 under Clang ASan/UBSan.
Local clipboard skip remains distinct from earlier unresolved clipboard findings; no NexaCloud source/pin or driveE: change.
R01 overall startup acceptance remains open; no performance gain inferred from the icon correction.

@echo off
call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64 >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%
cl /nologo /O2 /MD /std:c17 /utf-8 /W4 /Iinclude out/r02-transfer-capture.c build/Release/nexaui.lib /Foout/r02-transfer-capture.obj /Feout/r02-transfer-capture.exe /link user32.lib shell32.lib imm32.lib ole32.lib oleaut32.lib uiautomationcore.lib uuid.lib gdi32.lib advapi32.lib

@echo off
call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64 >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%
cl /nologo /O2 /MD /std:c17 /utf-8 /W4 /DR02_ALIAS /Iinclude out/r02-transfer-mutant.c build/Release/nexaui.lib /Foout/r02-transfer-alias.obj /Feout/r02-transfer-alias.exe /link user32.lib shell32.lib imm32.lib ole32.lib oleaut32.lib uiautomationcore.lib uuid.lib gdi32.lib advapi32.lib
if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%
cl /nologo /O2 /MD /std:c17 /utf-8 /W4 /DR02_NO_CLIP /Iinclude out/r02-transfer-mutant.c build/Release/nexaui.lib /Foout/r02-transfer-no-clip.obj /Feout/r02-transfer-no-clip.exe /link user32.lib shell32.lib imm32.lib ole32.lib oleaut32.lib uiautomationcore.lib uuid.lib gdi32.lib advapi32.lib

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
root=Path('D:/NexaUI');base=root/'out/r02-transfer';font=ImageFont.truetype('C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf',12)
frames=[];checks=[];pictures={}
names=['Dark','Light','High contrast','Midnight'];scales=[1,1.25,1.5,2]
for theme in range(1,5):
 for alpha in range(2):
  row=[]
  for density,scale in enumerate(scales):
   name=f't{theme}-d{density}-a{alpha}'
   hardware=Image.open(base/f'native-final-hardware-s24-{name}.ppm').convert('RGBA')
   warp=Image.open(base/f'native-final-warp-s24-{name}.ppm').convert('RGBA')
   cpu=(base/'after'/(name+'.rgba')).read_bytes()
   assert hardware.size==warp.size and hardware.width>=180 and hardware.height>=140
   assert hardware.tobytes()==warp.tobytes()
   assert hardware.crop((0,0,180,140)).tobytes()==cpu
   checks.append(dict(case=name,size=24,native_size=hardware.size,hardware_sha256=hashlib.sha256(hardware.tobytes()).hexdigest(),warp_sha256=hashlib.sha256(warp.tobytes()).hexdigest(),complete_cpu_rgba_match=True))
   pictures[name]=hardware.crop((0,0,180,140)).convert('RGB')
   hardware=Image.open(base/f'native-final-hardware-s26-{name}.ppm').convert('RGBA')
   warp=Image.open(base/f'native-final-warp-s26-{name}.ppm').convert('RGBA')
   assert hardware.size==warp.size and hardware.tobytes()==warp.tobytes()
   checks.append(dict(case=name,size=26,native_size=hardware.size,hardware_sha256=hashlib.sha256(hardware.tobytes()).hexdigest(),warp_sha256=hashlib.sha256(warp.tobytes()).hexdigest(),complete_cpu_rgba_match='In-test exact readback comparison; no separate raw CPU snapshot'))
   row.append(hardware.crop((0,0,180,140)).convert('RGB'))
  frames.append(row)
atlas=Image.new('RGB',(4*190,8*166),(20,25,35));draw=ImageDraw.Draw(atlas)
for row,images in enumerate(frames):
 for density,picture in enumerate(images):
  x=density*190+5;y=row*166
  draw.text((x,y+2),f'{names[row//2]} {scales[density]:g}x {"55%" if row%2 else "100%"} 26px',font=font,fill='white')
  atlas.paste(picture,(x,y+22))
atlas.save(root/'docs/images/transfer-icon-matrix.png')
before=Image.frombytes('RGBA',(180,140),(base/'before/t4-d3-a0.rgba').read_bytes()).convert('RGB')
after=pictures['t4-d3-a0']
comparison=Image.new('RGB',(400,116),(20,25,35));draw=ImageDraw.Draw(comparison)
for x,label,picture in [(10,'Before / 2x',(before)),(210,'After / 2x',(after))]:
 draw.text((x,3),label,font=font,fill='white');comparison.paste(picture.crop((0,0,180,66)),(x,24))
 draw.text((x,96),'Transfer    Upload    Download',font=font,fill='white')
comparison.save(root/'docs/images/transfer-icon-before-after.png')
(base/'native-pixel-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(cases=checks,full_native_pairs=64,complete_cpu_rgba_matches=32,annotation='Gallery headers use system font outside captured pixels; no magnification. Matrix26px, before/after24px at2x top-row crop; lower matrix row intentionally clipped'),indent=2)+'\n')
print('64 complete hardware/WARP images and32 separate CPU RGBA frames identical; native-density galleries written')
